picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's selection under DOE's new Genesis Mission signals a major federal bet on AI-driven control of particle accelerators, with implications for national lab infrastructure and fundamental physics research capacity.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: Penn's implantable Smart Neurostimulation System, the product of decades of computational memory modeling, represents a genuine clinical breakthrough with direct potential to treat memory loss disorders.
picks.title: A ‘breakthrough’ to restore memory | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell's creation of an entire new department around AI-powered liquid biopsy and single-cell genomics work marks a significant institutional bet on computational biomedicine as a discipline.
picks.title: Dr. Dan Landau Named Inaugural Chair of the Department of Systems and Computational Biomedicine at Weill Cornell Medicine
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: The $9M NSF-funded iDLab partnership between NCSA and UCLA builds shared national HPC infrastructure aligned with NAIRR, directly expanding academic access to AI compute resources.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's new AI-based compression method tackles a looming crisis in scientific data storage without sacrificing analytical fidelity, a technical advance with broad applicability across experimental physics.
picks.title: SLAC researchers develop AI-based tool to compress data without losing detail

picks.editorial_note: The FRONTEO-Science Tokyo Collaborative Research Cluster pairs an industry AI drug-discovery platform with academic biomedical research, an industry-academia model likely to accelerate pharmaceutical AI applications.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: ASU's AI analysis of antibody signatures from over 4,000 people to predict vaccine response strength is a large-scale, real-world demonstration of AI's growing role in personalized immunology.
picks.title: Why immune responses to vaccines vary from person to person

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston's projection of a 32% electricity demand increase by 2030, driven substantially by AI and data centers, is exactly the kind of research that should inform energy infrastructure and policy planning.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: A $1.5M NSF grant backing a multi-institution collaboration to model macromolecular systems with AI extends the reach of machine learning into fundamental structural biology research.
picks.title: $1.5 million NSF grant will support KU research modeling molecular systems using AI

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's decision to provide Claude access to all teams in the World Solar Challenge, building on CSIRO's technical partnership, is a notable case of a frontier AI lab directly democratizing access within an academic/engineering competition.
picks.title: World's toughest solar race unlocks AI access for all teams
